newsitem.title: POLAND: Zloty firms vs basket, money market stays short.
newsitem.headline: Zloty firms vs basket, money market stays short.

text.p: The Polish zloty closed firmer against the basket of currencies despite a light midday currency buying trend as players turned to sell small amounts of currencies just before the fixing, dealers said.
They said the zloty rise was also fuelled by the cash strapped money market and that it could move further up if the central bank did not intervene to stop it.

"Keeping long positions in currencies is pointless due to high money market rates...the NBP is not likely to intervenue and we may see the zloty testing the three-percent-from-parity level soon," said Bogdan Stepkowski from ING Bank in Warsaw.
